officialReferenceCaveat: This dataset is a third-party, community-packaged copy of Indonesia administrative region data (cahyadsn/wilayah, MIT License), not an official Kementerian Dalam Negeri (Kemendagri) API or export. It should not be treated as a substitute for an operator's own official legal/compliance reference.

files.areaSourceReference: Badan Informasi Geospasial, Surat Deputi Bidang Informasi Geospasial Dasar Nomor B-16.10/DIGD-BIG/IGD.04.04/12/2024, 16 Desember 2024

notes: Every sha256/bytes value here is verified against the real file on disk by tests/idn-admin-regions-vendor-manifest.test.ts, and every non-null decreeReference must appear verbatim in that file's own header — so a silently swapped dataset fails the build instead of being served as if it were this one.

decreeReference is recorded PER FILE, read from each file's own header, because upstream does not ship one decree for the whole dataset: db/wilayah.sql, db/wilayah_penduduk.sql and db/wilayah_luas.sql cite Kepmendagri 300.2.2-2138/2025 while db/wilayah_pulau.sql cites 300.2.2-2430/2025. db/wilayah_penduduk.sql wraps the reference across two header lines, so it is compared with whitespace folded (awcms-one corrected an earlier note here that said this header names no decree at all).

db/wilayah_luas.sql's codes follow the decree, but its AREA figures come from Badan Informasi Geospasial (areaSourceReference, also read from the file's own header). The area is BIG's, never attributed to Kemendagri.

importedBy names the code that actually reads the file: idn_admin_regions for db/wilayah.sql, and idn_admin_regions.population for db/wilayah_penduduk.sql and db/wilayah_luas.sql (awcms-one ADR-0053, `bun run idn-population:import`, a local addition of the awcms-one embed). db/wilayah_pulau.sql is read by nothing; it is vendored from the SAME upstream commit so a future island feature does not have to guess which version matches the imported hierarchy.

Upstream db/ also contains wilayah_level_1_2.sql (a larger province/regency dataset with coordinates/elevation/timezone/boundaries) and an archive/ folder of superseded prior-year datasets. Neither is vendored; adding one is a deliberate new entry here, never an assumption that it is already present.
This is GLOBAL reference data, not tenant-scoped — see ADR-0046 and src/modules/idn-admin-regions/README.md.
